big_case.notes: The question (whether McDonnell Douglas burden-shifting belongs at summary judgment in Title VII cases) matters nationally and two Justices have invited it, and four cert-stage amicus briefs arrived after the call for a response. But the vehicle is an unpublished Ninth Circuit memorandum in a single-employee termination dispute, and the petition was denied at its first post-response conference with no noted dissent or statement, so the case itself changed nothing.
